description: This PHP file is a controller class for managing tax classes within the Opencart e-commerce platform's admin panel. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, and deleting tax class entries, handling web requests, preparing view data, and interacting with models.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Controller class for creating, reading, updating, and deleting tax classes within the Opencart admin interface, including handling permissions, validation, and view rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list page of tax classes, initializes view data, loads necessary controllers and templates.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to refresh the tax class list, outputs the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches the list of tax classes from the model, handles pagination, and renders the tax class list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a tax class, populates form data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submissions to add or update a tax class, includes validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected tax classes after permission checks and product association validation.
